description: This file defines internal interfaces, data structures, and related types for the Orleans system's activation repartitioning features, including messaging contracts and metadata structures used for grain migration planning and exchange between silos.

classes.name: Edge
classes.description: Represents a directed communication edge between two vertices, with methods for flipping direction and comparison.

classes.name: EdgeVertex
classes.description: Represents a vertex in the edge graph, identified by GrainId and associated silo information, with migratability flag.

classes.name: CandidateVertex
classes.description: Represents a grain candidate for transfer, including transfer score and connected vertices.

classes.name: CandidateConnectedVertex
classes.description: Represents a connection to another grain with an associated transfer score.

classes.name: AcceptExchangeRequest
classes.description: Represents a request from a silo to transfer grains, including the exchange set and snapshot of activation count.

classes.name: AcceptExchangeResponse
classes.description: Represents the response to an exchange request, indicating success or type of failure, along with accepted and given grains.

methods.name: GetReference
methods.description: Obtains a system target reference for the activation repartitioner on a specified silo.

methods.name: TriggerExchangeRequest
methods.description: Initiates an exchange request for repartitioning grains.

methods.name: AcceptExchangeRequest
methods.description: Handles an incoming request to accept a grain exchange.

methods.name: ResetCounters
methods.description: Resets internal counters, intended for testing.

methods.name: GetActivationCount
methods.description: Retrieves the current activation count, mainly for testing purposes.

methods.name: SetActivationCountOffset
methods.description: Adjusts the activation count offset, mainly for testing.

methods.name: GetGrainCallFrequencies
methods.description: Provides diagnostics info on grain call frequencies.
